instruction: Give me 3 comma-separated artist names with the most songs in my Spotify playlists. If the same song is present in multiple playlists, count it once.
notes: Read-only information-gathering task (evaluation requires no model changes). The library listing, per-playlist song listing and per-song artist lookup are modeled with one representative playlist and one representative song; at runtime show_playlist is repeated for every playlist in the library and show_song for every distinct song id (duplicates across playlists are counted once). The aggregation (songs per artist, top 3) is computed offline from the show_song responses and passed as the comma-separated answer to supervisor.complete_task, which is forced to be the last action via (task-completed). Spotify username is the supervisor's email; password comes from supervisor.show_account_passwords.
